killedBy: capture.mjs: the aria object each measured element carries (issue #937) records an EMPTY attribute as an empty string, distinct from no attribute
capture.mjs: the aria object each measured element carries (issue #937) is handed the nine names by measure, which is the call a real capture makes
why: Tests the attribute's truthiness instead of its presence, so aria-label="" is silently not recorded. An empty accessible name is exactly the defect a reviewer most needs to see -- it blanks the name of a control that has visible text -- and the capture would hide it as if the attribute were not there.
